_why: verify.py is the only thing that notices when a plugin or npm reinstall drops the omc-codex-mcp-no-type patch: the SessionStart patch-verify hook trusts its exit code. These rows prove the tests would notice if verify.py stopped detecting a dropped patch, whether in the static check, in the exit code, or in the render probe.

mutations.name: static-drop-not-recorded
mutations._mechanism: A file that went back to the upstream emission line is no longer recorded as missing. A bundle-only drop (bridge/cli.cjs, which the render probe never loads) then reads VERIFY: OK.

mutations.name: missing-exits-zero
mutations._mechanism: MISSING is printed, but the exit code is 0. The SessionStart hook reads only the exit code, so it would stay silent.

mutations.name: probe-type-lines-ignored
mutations._mechanism: The render probe's `type` count is never acted on. An emission the static regex does not know (marker present, second spelling) reads VERIFY: OK.

mutations.name: lookup-misses-updated-install
mutations._mechanism: roots() stops reading installed_plugins.json. After an OMC update repoints installPath at a fresh, unpatched version, only the patched npm copy is checked and verify.py prints VERIFY: OK files=2: the update dropped the patch silently.
